video.title: AI欧腐《饥渴吸血鬼校霸想占有我/That Thirsty Vampire Schoolbully Wants to Claim Me》
video.desc:
Moving into his new family’s massive mansion, Liam only wanted a safe place to call home. Instead, he gets Silas, a dangerously hot stepbrother who treats him like prey. Silas loves playing sick games. Liam fights back every time. But late one night, armed assassins break into the house. Silas flashes his fangs and turns into a terrifying monster to save Liam's life. Turns out, the arrogant stepbrother is actually a bloodthirsty vampire—and he's madly addicted to Liam's blood...
连恩搬进新家庭的宏伟豪宅，只想要一个能安身的安全住所，没想到却遇上危险又帅得离谱的继兄赛拉斯，对方将他视为猎物。赛拉斯热爱玩变态游戏，连恩每次都奋力反击。但某天深夜，武装刺客闯入宅邸，赛拉斯露出獠牙、变成骇人的怪物救下连恩的性命。原来这位傲慢的继兄其实是嗜血的吸血鬼，而且他对连恩的血疯狂上瘾……

可能有人看过 但我最近看很多没什么喜欢的新的 就发发这种我个人看着觉得还不错的
